title: Lotofácil da Independência 2026: All About the Special Draw
seoTitle: Lotofácil da Independência 2026: All About the Special.
subtitle: Draw 3780 to be held on September 15th with an estimated R$300 million prize
excerpt: The Lotofácil da Independência 2026, draw 3780, will be held on September 15th at 11 AM. The estimated prize reaches R$300 million and does not accumulate, generating.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The special Lotofácil da Independência 2026 draw gained prominence after the official announcement by Caixa Econômica Federal. The draw, number 3780, will take place on September 15th, with an estimated prize of R$ 300 million.

Date, Time, and Format of the Draw

The draw will be held on Tuesday, September 15th, at 11 AM, a different time from regular draws. Exclusive bets for the special edition began on September 3rd and close at 10 AM on the day of the draw.

How to Bet and Cost of Betting

To participate, the bettor must choose between 15 and 20 numbers from the 25 available on the ticket. A simple bet, with 15 numbers, costs R$ 3.50. It is possible to mark the numbers manually, use 'Surpresinha' (random numbers), or opt for 'Teimosinha,' which repeats the same bet for up to 24 consecutive draws.

Non-Accumulation Rule and Prize Distribution

The main prize of Lotofácil da Independência does not accumulate. If no bettor matches all 15 numbers, the amount allocated to the main prize tier is redistributed among the winners of the next tier, following the order of 14, 13, 12, and 11 matches.

Most Frequent Numbers in Previous Editions

  • 03 – drawn 13 times
  • 06 – drawn 12 times
  • 05 – drawn 11 times
  • 25 – drawn 11 times
  • 12 – drawn 10 times
  • 22 – drawn 10 times
  • 23 – drawn 10 times

Betting Options and Sales Channels

Bets can be placed at accredited lottery houses, through the Loterias Caixa portal, or via the official app. Payment accepts credit card, debit card, Pix, or Mercado Pago. For those who prefer to play in groups, 'Bolão Caixa' allows purchasing shares starting from R$ 4.50, with a minimum investment of R$ 14.00.

With information from G1, Rádio Itatiaia, Seu Dinheiro.
